title: Exactness of integral continuous scalar localization
statement: For prime ℓ and a normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra E which is a field, let a:O_E→E be the closed-unit-ball inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. On every scheme X, the actual extension-of-scalars functor along coefficientMap(a,X) between internal module sheaves preserves finite limits.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, localization on compact profinite tests

proof.text: In presheaves on profinite sets construct the sequential diagram of regular integral modules with transition multiplication by ℓ and nth cocone leg a↦a/ℓⁿ. The compact-test localization theorem proves surjectivity, and division by the nonzero ℓⁿ proves injectivity, giving the colimit universal property.

Apply monoidal sheafification and inverse image from the point to this colimit; explicit coefficient isomorphisms identify its stages with the regular integral module and its vertex with the restricted regular E module. Filtered colimits of flat internal modules are flat. The extension/forget/tensor comparison and reflection along the faithful forgetful functor give preservation of finite limits.
